decision_conditions:
1. The rooms in floor plan need to be labelled.
2. Schedule of Works required. 
3. HERITAGE STATEMENT Required
4.  We have amended description of development, please confirm you agree?
'Internal alterations consisting of removal of stud partitions and introduction of a new partition, the replacement of an existing internal roller shutter with a glazed screen and replacement of the existing signage above the door of the coffee shop entrance. External alteration including a new non-illuminated painted timber fascia sign above an existing sash window, along with introduction of frosted window film to  lower panes of the same sash window'.
reference_no_of_permission_being_relied_: A Full Planning application has previously been submitted at the request of the local planning authority in relation to the proposed use of part of the listed building as a coffee shop. A separate Advertisement Consent application will also been submitted for associated signage.
description: Internal alterations consisting of removal of stud partitions and introduction of a new partition with a new internal doorway, the replacement of an existing internal roller shutter with a glazed screen and replacement of the existing signage above the door of the coffee shop entrance. External alterations including a new non-illuminated painted timber fascia sign above an existing sash window, along with introduction of frosted window film to lower panes of the same sash window.
